findings.rule: Give one thing one name throughout a text, and never use that name for a second thing.
findings.input:
Its hits:

```text
{{ candidates }}
```

Each hit names a file, a line, a tier and a rule.
Skip the F hits: they are left to CI, not to this review.
Confirm or reject each H hit by reading its line in context.
A confirmed H hit is a finding.
findings.finding: This block calls check.sh's per-line output a "hit" throughout, while writing-prose/SKILL.md (which this same file tells the reviewer to read first for the tier definitions, and which this PR itself edits) calls the identical H-tier output a "candidate" in three places ("check.sh prints a candidate", "Confirm or dismiss every H candidate", "every H candidate is settled"), so the same object now carries two names across the two documents.
